parameters.question: Predict RNA secondary structures for the small RNAs in the provided FASTA file using ViennaRNA (RNAfold). Report the dot-bracket notation with minimum free energies for each sequence. Check that each sequence ID has a matching dot-bracket structure and an MFE value (kcal/mol) that agrees with the reference. Small differences in formatting, order or ViennaRNA version rounding are acceptable.

A semantic comparison checks that each sequence has the same dot-bracket structure and MFE without failing on layout or version differences.
